presets.name: Christmas light wrap
presets.description: The uploaded car is wrapped in warm white string lights in a blue-hour snowy scene.
presets.prompt: Use the uploaded car photo as the exact subject reference. Create one continuous four-second shot of the same car parked in a quiet snowy night scene at blue hour. Preserve the car's shape, color, model details and proportions exactly. Warm white string lights progressively wrap around the body, roof, mirrors and wheels arches, glowing softly and reflecting on the paint and wet snow. Light snow falls gently; slow cinematic orbit around the front three-quarter angle. Cozy holiday atmosphere. Keep the car's design, badges and proportions stable. No people, no scene cuts, no text, no logos, no morphing.
